signIn.heading: Sign in to your account
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to manage your Comfy plan and credits.
signIn.backToSocial: Sign in with Google or GitHub instead
signIn.pending: Finish signing in from the pop-up window.
signIn.insecureContextWarning: This connection is insecure (HTTP) - your credentials may be intercepted by attackers if you proceed to login.
signIn.sessionError: You are signed in, but your workspace session could not be started. Retry, or sign in again with another account.

errors.auth/invalid-email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.auth/user-disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact support.
errors.auth/email-already-in-use: We couldn't create an account with this email. Try signing in or resetting your password instead.
errors.auth/weak-password: Password is too weak. Please use a stronger password with at least 6 characters.
errors.auth/too-many-requests: Too many login attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.auth/operation-not-allowed: This sign-in method is not currently supported.
errors.auth/invalid-credential: Invalid login credentials. Please check your email and password.
errors.auth/network-request-failed: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.auth/popup-closed-by-user: The sign-in window closed before sign-in finished. Please try again.
errors.auth/cancelled-popup-request: Another sign-in window was already open, so this one was cancelled. Please try again.
errors.auth/popup-blocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Please allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
errors.auth/account-exists-with-different-crede: We couldn't sign you in with this method. Try another sign-in option, or reset your password to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.
errors.signupBlocked: We couldn't create your account right now. Please try again later. If this keeps happening, email support@comfy.org.

validation.maxLength: Must be no more than {length} characters

password.uppercase: Must contain at least one uppercase letter
password.lowercase: Must contain at least one lowercase letter
password.number: Must contain at least one number
password.special: Must contain at least one special character

checkout.stripeSecurity: Your payment details are handled securely by Stripe.
checkout.terms: By subscribing, you agree to recurring charges until cancellation.
checkout.successBody: Your plan was updated. A receipt was sent to your email.
checkout.methodChoice: Choose how you would like to pay.
checkout.alipayRenewalNote: Alipay renews this plan automatically each period until you cancel.
checkout.unavailable: The payment form isn't available right now. Please try again later.
checkout.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
checkout.reactivationConfirm: Your subscription was cancelled. I confirm the {amount} charge to reactivate it.

terms.agreement: By continuing, you agree to Comfy Org's {terms} and {privacy}, and authorize Comfy Org to charge your payment method each billing period until you cancel.

column.title: The payment form couldn't load
column.body: Nothing has been charged. Check your connection and try again — your order details are unaffected.

element.title: The payment form couldn't load
element.body: Nothing has been charged. Check your connection and try again, or pay with a saved payment method.

saved.title: Your saved payment methods couldn't load
saved.body: Nothing has been charged. Try again, or pay with a new payment method.

declined.title: Payment declined
declined.body: Your card couldn't be charged. Try another card, or contact your bank if this looks wrong.

processing_error.title: Payment couldn't be processed
processing_error.body: There was a technical problem on the payment side. Try again, or refresh the page if it keeps happening.

not_completed.title: Payment not completed
not_completed.body: Your payment wasn't completed, so you haven't been charged. Pay to try again, or use a different payment method.

price_updated.title: The price has updated
price_updated.body: Your quote expired, so the numbers were refreshed. Review the new total before paying — you have not been charged.

keepSubscription.title: Your plan was set to end on {date}
keepSubscription.titleUndated: Your plan was set to end
keepSubscription.checkbox: Keep my subscription and renew it
keepSubscription.required: Check the box to keep your subscription, then pay.

body.upgrade: Upgrading keeps your subscription, and it renews that day at {amount}.
body.downgrade: Switching to {plan} keeps your subscription, and it renews that day at {amount}.
body.to_yearly: Switching to yearly keeps your subscription. It renews on {date} at {amount}.
body.to_monthly: Switching to monthly keeps your subscription, and it renews that day at {amount}.
body.commitment: Changing your commitment keeps your subscription, and it renews that day at {amount}.
body.other: This change keeps your subscription, and it renews that day at {amount}.

waiting.body: A payment for this workspace is still going through. This page will update on its own; nothing more is needed from you.

ending.closeLine: You can close this page. We'll email your invoice once this goes through and this page will automatically update.

success.title: You're all set
success.body: Your plan for {workspace} has been successfully updated.

completed.title: You're all set
completed.body: A payment on this workspace completed — check your plan in settings.

already_completed.title: Already completed
already_completed.body: This payment for {workspace} already went through. You won't be charged again.

in_progress.title: Payment in progress
in_progress.body: Your bank is still settling this payment — this can take up to a day. Nothing more is needed from you, and don't pay again: you could be charged twice.
in_progress.codeLabel: If nothing has changed after 24 hours, contact support with this code:

received.title: Payment received
received.body: Your payment went through and you should receive your credits or subscription soon. You won't be charged again.
received.codeLabel: If nothing has changed after 24 hours, contact support with this code:

unconfirmed.title: We couldn't confirm your payment
unconfirmed.body: Your payment may or may not have gone through. Don't pay again yet, you could be charged twice.
unconfirmed.codeLabel: If this page still can't confirm it after a few minutes, contact support with this code:

refused.title: Checkout not available
refused.body: Billing for this workspace is managed by its owner. Ask them to make this change.
refused.codeLabel: If this is an error, contact support with this code:

plan_unavailable.title: This plan is no longer available
plan_unavailable.body: The plan in your link isn't offered anymore. Nothing has been charged. See our current plans instead.
plan_unavailable.codeLabel: If you think this is a mistake, contact support with this code:

load_failed.title: Couldn't load your checkout
load_failed.body: We couldn't load your quote. Nothing has been charged. Try again, or contact support if this keeps happening.
load_failed.codeLabel: If this keeps happening, contact support with this code:

entryError.title: We couldn't open that billing page
entryError.unknown: That link isn't a billing request we recognise. Go back and try again.
entryError.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: That link uses an older billing address. Update the app you came from and try again.
entryError.UNKNOWN_INTENT: That link asks for a billing page that doesn't exist.
entryError.UNKNOWN_PRODUCT: That link doesn't say which product sent you here.
entryError.UNKNOWN_RETURN_TARGET: That link doesn't name a place we can send you back to.
entryError.INVALID_PLAN: That link names a plan we can't read.
entryError.INVALID_CORRELATION_ID: That link carries a reference we can't read.
entryError.INVALID_WORKSPACE_ID: That link names a workspace we can't read.
entryError.INVALID_TEAM_CREDIT_STOP_ID: That link names a credit amount we can't read.

failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
failure.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
failure.ACCESS_DENIED: This account can't manage billing for that workspace.
failure.WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: This account can't access that workspace. Reopen billing from the app while signed in with the right account.
failure.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that billing record.
failure.CONFLICT: That change conflicts with your current subscription.
failure.SUPERSEDED: Your workspace changed while we were loading. Please try again.
failure.REQUEST_FAILED: We couldn't reach the billing service. Please try again.
failure.MALFORMED_RESPONSE: The billing service sent something we couldn't read.
failure.INVALID_REQUEST: That plan change isn't a request we can make.
failure.NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION: There is no active subscription to change.
failure.REACTIVATION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm the reactivation charge before continuing.
failure.CONFLICTING_PAYMENT_METHOD: That request named two payment methods; choose one.
failure.MISSING_PAYMENT_METHOD_URL: The billing service asked for a payment step but didn't say where.

subscription.noPlan: You are not on a paid plan yet.
subscription.cancelConfirm: Cancel your subscription? You can resubscribe at any time.

paymentMethods.empty: No payment method is saved for this workspace.

invoices.body: Invoices and receipts are kept by our payment provider. Open the billing portal to view and download them.

result.none: There is no payment in progress for this workspace.

landing.body: Open billing from your Comfy product to manage your plan, payment methods and invoices.

outcome.unknown: That didn't complete. Please try again.
outcome.failed: That change didn't go through. Please try again.
outcome.timed_out: We stopped waiting for the billing service. Check back in a moment.
outcome.reconciliation_needed: That change needs a look from support before it completes.
outcome.superseded: Your workspace changed while we were working. Please try again.
